tools.name: myio_about
tools.description: Overview of the myIO documentation: what myIO is, the current product line and its availability, how hardware and older names in the docs map to product names (e.g. Due = myIO Server V3), what version marks such as [4.x] mean, and the list of sources.

tools.name: myio_toc
tools.description: Table of contents of the myIO documentation: every section id with its title and size. Optional filters: source (manual, api, faq, products, site) and text contained in the section title.

tools.name: myio_search
tools.description: Keyword search in the myIO documentation (manual, API reference, FAQ, product data). The content is in Hungarian: Hungarian keywords match best, and matching ignores accents and Hungarian word endings. Returns section ids, URLs, version marks and a snippet; myio_read returns the full section.

tools.name: myio_read
tools.description: Full text (Markdown) of one section of the myIO documentation, by its id from myio_search or myio_toc. Long sections come in parts; the response names the next part.
